reconcile.connective: MHC resolves the order by distinguishing two calls: an early acquaintance under John (John 1) and a later, formal summons to full-time discipleship (Matthew 4).

discrepancy.connective: Steve Wells's Skeptic's Annotated Bible calls the timelines flatly incompatible: John has the brothers following Jesus while the Baptist was 'not yet cast into prison.'

skeptic.name: Steve Wells
skeptic.work: The Skeptic's Annotated Bible, "Which came first: the calling of Peter and Andrew or the imprisonment of John the Baptist?" (skepticsannotatedbible.com/contra/imprisonment.html)
skeptic.attribution: Steve Wells, The Skeptic's Annotated Bible (2013), "Which came first: the calling of Peter and Andrew or the imprisonment of John the Baptist?"

excerpts.excerpt_text: …the two former, and, probably, the two latter also, had had acquaintance with Christ before (Joh 1:40, Joh 1:41), but were not till now called into a close and constant attendance upon him.
excerpts.on_tension_rationale: Directly answers 'which came first' by distinguishing an earlier acquaintance under John (John 1:40-41) from the later formal call recorded in Matthew 4, so the two Gospel orders describe two different moments rather than one contradicted event.

pd_work.resource: John Haley, An Examination of the Alleged Discrepancies of the Bible (1874)
pd_work.author: John Haley
pd_work.note: Haley lists this exact pair under 'Historical Discrepancies' ('Apostles called at one time. At a different time.' John 1:35-43 vs. Matt 4:18-22/Mark 1:16-20/Luke 5:1-11), explaining that John records 'the first interview' after which the disciples 'returned for a while to their ordinary employment' before being 'called to the apostolic office' later; he separately notes the Matt 4:12/Mark 1:14 vs. John 3:2,22,24 imprisonment-timing question as a minor chronological-arrangement discrepancy.

link.title: GotQuestions: Why is the order of Jesus' calling His disciples different in some of the gospels?
link.note: argues John records an introductory meeting and the Synoptics the later, formal calling to discipleship, the same two-stage harmonization Haley and MHC give
